detail: Full summary: Housekeeping preview/execute asymmetry worth remembering: preview reported 'remove 130 duplicates' but execute reported dedupe 0 and archive 247 — the archive pass swept the duplicates, so the two summaries describe the same work differently. Not a bug, but the preview undersells how much the archive pass will move.
